verdict.rationale: Chargebee's API docs show broad REST coverage of core billing objects (subscriptions, usage events, exports, quotes, hosted pages, webhooks, idempotency, business entities), suggesting most UI actions have API equivalents, and an API Explorer lets users test calls live. However there is no explicit documentation stating full UI/API parity, and several UI-centric features (entitlements management UI, AI-draft pricing setup, Dunning configuration) are described only as UI capabilities without a clear corresponding API path in the evidence. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement, evidence that all admin/config UI actions (entitlements, dunning rules, AI draft) are scriptable via API, and independent confirmation of completeness.
